renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: event_volcano
  title: Splicing change against significance
  description: |-
    Each point is a splicing event in one contrast: its change in exon inclusion (delta PSI) on the horizontal axis and its FDR on the vertical axis, coloured by event type. It answers which events change most, in which direction, and how confidently.
    How to read: events in the upper left and upper right corners lose or gain inclusion in the treatment with strong support. A cloud with nothing above the line means little differential splicing, so check the replicate coverage before trusting the contrast. Open the table tile for the labelled genes.
    Lines and annotations: the horizontal line is an FDR of 0.05, the level at which rMATS counts an event as significant in its summary. No delta PSI line is drawn: the rnasplice template passes its MIN_DPSI variable to this recipe's min_dpsi parameter with a default of 0, so the call adds no floor on the change. A value above 0 is the user's own working value, not an rMATS default.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xinglab/rmats-turbo/master/README.md
  kind: volcano
  config:
    significance_threshold: 0.05
    effect_threshold: 0.0
    top_n_labels: 10
    effect_label: Change in inclusion (delta PSI)
    significance_label: -log10 FDR
  roles:
    feature_id: event_id
    effect_size: dpsi
    significance: fdr
    label: gene_name
    category: event_type

- component: advanced_viz
  id: event_record
  title: Splicing event record
  description: |-
    The card shows every field of one splicing event: its gene, type, coordinates, inclusion per condition, change in inclusion, FDR and read support. It answers what exactly is known about the event picked in the table or the volcano.
    How to read: select a row in the table to fill the card. Compare the inclusion in both conditions with the read counts, since a large change on few reads is weak evidence.
  kind: record_card
  roles:
    id: event_id
    title: gene_name

- component: figure
  id: event_types
  title: Events by type and direction
  description: |-
    Each bar is an event type, split by whether its events gain inclusion, lose it or do not change significantly. It answers which kinds of splicing carry the differences between the conditions.
    How to read: a type whose bar is mostly significant is where the treatment acts. Bars that are almost entirely not significant point to little signal for that type.
  visu_type: histogram
  dict_kwargs:
    x: event_type
    color: direction
    barmode: stack
    labels:
      event_type: Event type
      direction: Direction of change

- component: card
  title: Events tested
  description: |-
    The hero number is the count of distinct events with enough reads to be tested, and the ring splits them by event type. It answers how much splicing the run covered and of what kind.
    How to read: a type that is missing may have had too few reads to pass the coverage filter, so check the sequencing depth.
  column: event_id
  aggregation: nunique
  aggregations:
  - count
  secondary_layout: donut
  breakdown_col: event_type
  caption: events, by type

- component: card
  title: Size of the inclusion change
  description: |-
    The hero number is the median absolute change in exon inclusion across events, and the box shows its quartiles. It answers how large the splicing differences are overall.
    How to read: a box close to zero means most events are unchanged and the signal sits in a few. Filter to one event type or contrast to see where the larger changes are.
  column: abs_dpsi
  aggregation: median
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  caption: quartiles of the absolute change

- component: interactive
  title: Event type
  description: Restricts every tile to the chosen event types, such as skipped exons or retained introns.
    It answers whether a pattern holds within one kind of splicing.
  interactive_type: MultiSelect
  column_name: event_type

- component: table
  title: Splicing events
  description: |-
    Each row is a splicing event in one contrast, with its gene, coordinates, inclusion in both conditions, change in inclusion, FDR and significance call. It answers which events to follow up.
    How to read: sort by FDR or by the absolute change and select a row to fill the event record.
  row_selection_enabled: true
  row_selection_column: event_id
